final_netlist:
.subckt dut iin iout vdd vss
* NMOS self-biased cascode sink mirror, ratio 1, 20 uA. Rev 6.
* Sizes: W=192 L=6 m=2 -> W/L = 64 -> Vov ~0.07 V at 20 uA.
* Reference cascode M2 is diode-connected (gate = iin), so it is always saturated.
* Output cascode M4 uses the same gate node (gc = iin ~ 0.77 V).
* Since x = iin - Vgs2 and y = iin - Vgs4 with matched devices at equal current,
* x = y and both bottom devices see the same Vds.
* Reference branch: iin -> M2 (diode cascode) -> x -> M1 (bottom) -> vss
M1 x    g   vss vss nfet W=192 L=6 m=2
M2 iin  iin x   vss nfet W=192 L=6 m=2
* Output branch: iout -> M4 (cascode, gate = iin) -> y -> M3 (bottom) -> vss
M3 y    g   vss vss nfet W=192 L=6 m=2
M4 iout iin y   vss nfet W=192 L=6 m=2
* Bottom-gate bias: diode M5 (same size as M1) fed by R1.
* Vgs ~ 0.65 V at 20 uA -> R1 = (1.8 - 0.65)/20u ~ 57k
M5 g    g   vss vss nfet W=192 L=6 m=2
R1 vdd  g   57k
.ends dut
